info.description: Versioned REST API for Memotron. Authenticate with a personal access token as a Bearer token. Lists page with cursors, writes accept an Idempotency-Key, and errors are RFC 9457 problem details.
info.title: Memotron API

get.description: Collections and types of the app's records. Requires memotron:read (or nucleum). Pages are ordered by `sort` and continue with `cursor`. Archived records are left out unless `isArchived=true` is given, which lists the records that are archived themselves.

post.description: Requires memotron:write (or nucleum). Repeating the request with the same `Idempotency-Key` and body does not write again: it answers with the record's current state and `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. A key belongs to the token's account, this operation and the record it targets, and is remembered for 24 hours (a create key keeps naming the record it created). Sending it again with another body gets a 422 problem with code `idempotency_key_reused`; an update sent again while the first is still being processed gets a 409 problem with code `idempotency_in_progress` and `Retry-After`.
